close_reason: Subsumed by the resolver oracle in PR #255 (bedrock-b28). #255 deletes the self-oracle property this ticket was filed against and replaces it with an independent versioned-interval history in which no production conflict, tree or encoding code participates, plus range_point_conflicts_test.exs, which calls Conflicts.check_conflicts/3 directly over a point x read-version table covering point-vs-range, exclusive end keys and version-window edges, and tree_extent_test.exs for range extents. That is this ticket's asked-for coverage. CONDITION: #255 competes with #248 for the same ticket and only one will land. #248 keeps the self-oracle and does NOT supply this coverage, so if #248 lands instead of #255, reopen this ticket.
description: Found while fixing bedrock-b28 (PR #248). The resolver's conflict_resolution property uses Conflicts.check_conflicts/3 as its own oracle, so it cannot catch bugs inside Conflicts — proven by hard-wiring check_conflicts to always :ok or always :abort and watching the property stay green. test/bedrock/data_plane/resolver/conflicts_test.exs is 57 lines and covers only the oldest_version floor. Add direct tests for the range-overlap logic (point vs range, adjacent ranges, exclusive end keys, version window edges) with hand-computed expected verdicts so a broken Conflicts fails loudly.
title: Conflicts.check_conflicts/3 overlap logic is thinly covered: conflicts_test.exs only exercises the oldest_version floor
